To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the phase images of the holograms recorded at low magnification contain the phase of the wave function of the electron beam and that this phase can be used to determine the phase of the electron wave function in the object plane.
the phase of a transmitted electron wave can be recorded by electron holography and interpreted to obtain quantitative information on the electron potential of an investigated sample.

electron holography can be successfully applied to study the magnetic properties of nanostructures and that the magnetic properties can be quantitatively analyzed by the phase images of electron holograms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the recording, processing and interpretation of holograms.
recording, processing and interpreting electron holograms.
the recording, the processing and the interpretation of low magnification electron holograms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
electron holography is a very useful tool for materials science, but not for high resolution microscopy.
electron holography is a powerful method to study phase objects.
electron holography is a powerful tool to obtain phase contrast images with high resolution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electron holography is a powerful method for recording the phase of electron waves and that it is possible to correct the spherical aberration in a TEM by applying the holographic principle.
we developed the necessary tools to make electron holography a powerful technique to investigate the phase distribution in materials.
the electron holography has become a powerful technique to investigate magnetic fields and to measure the phase shift in the specimen.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hologram is a complex function of the electron beam intensity, the electron beam position on the detector plane, and the electron beam phase shift.
the phase images obtained by electron holography can be used as a tool for the interpretation of the recorded holograms.
the phase of a wave is a very sensitive measure of the local properties of the medium through which it is passing.
